facts.fact: A Leadership editorial says presidential assent to the National Identity Management Commission Act 2026 repealed the 2007 legislation and that Nigeria is moving to strict statutory enforcement of the NIN across banking, telecoms and social safety nets.

The editorial describes the NIMC Act 2026 as setting a framework for unified national identity governance and database interoperability across ministries and agencies, with the NIN as the cornerstone of civic verification and biometric tracking.
